about_the_game:
Welcome to our immersive Nature Yoga application, where you can enhance your practice like never before. Our innovative features make learning and perfecting yoga poses both fun and effective.

Key Features:

Diverse Environments and Music:

Enhance your yoga sessions with dozens of nature environments, including mountains, oceans, rivers, deserts, and grasslands. Each setting comes with music, creating a serene and immersive environment for your practice.

Interactive Observation:

Use your mouse to control the perspective, allowing you to observe the yoga instructor from any angle. This ensures you can accurately imitate the instructor's movements and improve your form.

Slow Motion Replay:

Introduce precision into your practice with our slow-motion feature. By clicking the panda button, you can replay recent actions in slow motion. Customize the duration and speed of the slow motion to suit your learning pace. The game includes about 50 yoga poses, giving you a wide variety to practice and perfect.

Flexible Tutor and Exercise Selection:

Personalize your experience by choosing your AI Yoga Tutor as either male or female. You can also switch between different yoga exercises and instructors to keep your practice varied and engaging. Each instructor offers a unique set of exercises, providing a diverse and comprehensive yoga experience.

Fast Forward and Rewind:

Easily navigate through your practice with the ability to fast forward to the next pose or rewind to the previous pose. This feature ensures that you can focus on perfecting each movement at your own pace.

Join us in this unique yoga experience and take your practice to the next level with interactive and adjustable features designed for optimal learning and enjoyment.
